verdict.rationale: Jira's own feature page claims company-level visibility into progress as projects advance and coordination of initiatives across teams, which points toward a cross-project roll-up. But the evidence never names or describes a dedicated portfolio view or how project progress is aggregated into it. One community user found top-down planning frustrating and advised ignoring the portfolio add-ons; that is opinion rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence but does not make the claim disputed. Missing for 10: a documented first-party portfolio or roll-up view, details of how progress aggregates across projects, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view

citations.quote: Get visibility on your company's progress towards top priorities as projects advance
Connect engineering, product, and marketing initiatives to coordinate big launches across every team.
